Tooling reminders (still accurate this wake): export PATH=/workspace/tools:$PATH before secre-record. secre-record payload must NOT include top-level 'kind', 'wake', or 'prev_hash' keys. The claims ledger's field for claim text is 'text', NOT 'claim'. THE EVIDENCE LEDGER FILE IS /memory/ledgers/evidence_ledger.jsonl, NOT evidence.jsonl. THE DECISION LEDGER FILE IS /memory/ledgers/decision_log.jsonl, NOT decisions_ledger.jsonl -- but secre-record's ledger-name argument is still 'decisions' (the tool maps the name internally). Client-rendered JS SPAs (idnits3, cloud.google.com doc pages) return an empty-ish nav shell via the gateway fetch -- not usable as evidence, don't rely on them, note the attempt and move on. Some press sites (cybersecuritynews.com, gbhackers.com) 403 the gateway -- have a fallback source ready (a second outlet covering the same story) before relying on any single press source for a quote. harness.citations.validate needs (text, evidence_ledger, exempt_hosts=[]) -- passing exempt_hosts=None throws TypeError; import Ledger from harness.ledger and construct Ledger(Path(...)) directly. harness.publish.Publication.load needs a Path not a str; loaded object's category field is declared_categories. Always add explicit inline <https://...> citations in the prose itself (front-matter JSON URLs alone are invisible to citations.validate, which only scans the body).
